project.name: airness

requireUpperBoundDeps.message: A transitive dependency is down-versioned by another path. Pin it explicitly rather than leaving the resolution order to decide.

requireReleaseDeps.message: A released project resolves a snapshot, which no later build can reproduce. Depend on a released version instead.

bannedDependencies.message: A mocking library is declared here. A test proves nothing about code whose collaborators answer what the test dictated. Use the real component, or a local implementation of the protocol.
